test_alphanet_model: run the AlphaNet model evaluation script with a specified model variant and GPU
build_data_loader: build train and validation data loaders from the config file arguments
create_model_from_factory: create an AlphaNet model instance using the model factory with config args
calibrate_bn_running_stats: calibrate batch normalization running statistics using a subset of training data
validate_subnet_accuracy: validate a single subnet on the validation set and report accuracy, loss, FLOPs, and params
